bundles.rationale: The positive rule licenses a distinction when the excerpt expressly contrasts the component’s concepts, as it does with causation and control. bundles.evidenceText: the big mistake that i think you're making greg is you're confusing causation and control

The default is none without a defect cue; attribution-error and invalid-inference are excluded because neither a wrong source nor an inferential failure is alleged.
